title: Test plan
description: How the requirements will be tested: scope, approach, environments, criteria to start and stop. Written from the requirements specification and the current behaviour, without the design spec. The test cases are in the test case specification.

scope.description: Requirement ids in scope, and the features or components under test.

out_of_scope.description: What is deliberately not tested, and why.

approach.description: Which levels are used for what, e.g. 'integration tests for query results', 'stand for UI and plan shape', 'production checks by the user for load'.

environments.description: Each environment and its limits, e.g. 'stand: small data, proves plan shape not timings'.

entry_criteria.description: What must hold before stand testing starts, e.g. 'CI green on the head'.

exit_criteria.description: What must hold to call testing done.

risks.description: What could make the results misleading, and how the plan handles it.

approach: stand: history page in a browser, plan shape for NFR1, log search for NFR2
environments: stand: small history tables; proves plan shape and logging, not timings
exit_criteria: every stand case of ticket and profile requirements passes
risks: stand data too small for timings: timings are production checks
